prompt:

Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 52% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 21%, 51% and 84% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, lotus pond formations in VIVID PINK and DEEP EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries solid polished rose-quartz stone fused directly into her own form, soft natural veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING soft pink stone surface with VIVID white vein striations. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries living sakura blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING PINK blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
